name: scraperTC
install:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m pip install --user -e ".[dev]"
sudo ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/bin/scrapertc" /usr/local/bin/scrapertc
sudo ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/bin/cardhunt" /usr/local/bin/cardhunt
sudo ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/bin/pytest" /usr/local/bin/pytest
sudo ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/bin/ruff" /usr/local/bin/ruff
start:
set -euo pipefail
if curl -sf -o /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/status; then
  echo "CardHunt already listening on :8787"
  exit 0
fi
exec cardhunt serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8787
